mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS declined by at least 0.1% over the past month, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE exceeded 5.0%, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.0% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% (annualized), it signals a tightening monetary cycle that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (annualized), or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by GDP growth above 2.0% and unemployment rate below 4.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to overvaluation and rising interest rates, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where GDPC1 growth exceeded 2.0% and UNRATE was below 4.0%, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months signals a weakening economy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO declined by at least 0.5% over the past two months, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month signals a deteriorating labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where PAYEMS declined by at least 0.5% over the past month, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals a weakening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where HOUST declined by at least 1.0% over the past two months, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3.0% (annualized) over the past month, it signals inflationary pressure that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL growth exceeded 3.0% annually, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
